quiz.explain: Dream is a full-canvas masked dLLM initialized from Qwen2.5 7B weights and trained for 0.6T tokens: masked family by state and granularity, adapted by provenance.

SSD-LM diffuses on the vocabulary simplex (continuous state), decodes semi-autoregressively in blocks of 25, and initializes from RoBERTa-large: proof that the state-space and granularity axes are independent.

Trick entry: with one token per block the within-block diffusion is vacuous, so this is an ordinary autoregressive language model wearing a diffusion name. Exact likelihood, full KV cache, one token per step.
TESS 2 is a simplex-space (continuous) generalist adapted from Mistral-7B by continued pretraining with the diffusion loss: evidence the adaptation flag travels across families.
Duo is uniform-state: tokens transition between real values, and the family's Gaussian dual imports consistency distillation for few-step sampling, roughly two orders of magnitude faster.
